name: com.silkyseal.kerr
description: Real-time spinning (Kerr) black hole for URP: GPU null-geodesic tracing in Kerr-Schild coordinates, checked against a double-precision C# reference.

samples.description: The demo scene: a spinning black hole with its disk, the Milky Way and Hipparcos stars, a fly camera and the scripted plunge. Needs the Kerr renderer feature, with KerrTrace.compute assigned, on your URP renderer.
